title: Horrible Quality, Cheap & Deceptive
text: Horrible Quality, Cheap & Deceptive. I would give this zero stars if I could because the add is EXTREMELY  deceptive. It doesn’t look anything like the photo & the quality is not at all worth the price. I got this as a gift & didn’t see it until they opened it & was beyond embarrassed & disappointed. The ‘gears’ it shows don’t exist, it’s a cheep poorly made sticker in the center. It’s tiny, flimsy, & poor quality all around. I can’t urge you enough not to waste your money. Had I not gifted it I would return it. This is the most disappointing online purchase ever for me. If you want one of these there are much better quality ones elsewhere. Unless it’s for a gag gift that is supposed to be awful, don’t waste your time & money because you will be disappointed.
